rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a high-quality blastocyst consistent with 3AA, including strong ICM and TE and thinning zona. Minor issue is some overinterpretation of features not clearly verifiable from a single image and slight ambiguity between grade 3 and 4 expansion.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis. Minor weaknesses include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and a few assertions with limited support.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading, SET preference for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, and standard luteal support principles. Small deviations include speculative recommendations around endometrial thickness cutoffs, assisted hatching, and obesity-specific progesterone escalation.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management, counseling, and immediate lifestyle advice. Future cycle planning is less developed and some suggestions are more conditional than protocol-driven.
